name: X Posts
description: Follow public posts from one X account at their original publication times. Duplicate the plugin to follow another account.
author: Nunc.

aiTitle.description: Generate titles from post content using General AI. Requires AI permission and a configured General AI service. Falls back to the original text on failure.

username.description: One X username, with or without @ (for example, thsottiaux). Do not enter a profile URL.
